title: Contact details (Adresse, Telefonnummer, E-Mail)
summary: Give and ask for an address, a phone number and an email address, at the doctor's, in a course or for a new job.
goals: Ask for and give an address, a phone number and an email address

nicosWeg.title: Nicos Weg A1, chapter 2: Contact details (Adressen, Auf dem Amt)

sections.title: The questions
sections.text:
At the doctor's, at the gym, in a course, for a new job:

- [[Wie ist Ihre Adresse?]] - What is your address?
- [[Wie ist Ihre Telefonnummer?]] - What is your phone number?
- [[Wie ist Ihre E-Mail-Adresse?]] - What is your email address?

Informal: [[Wie ist deine Handynummer?]] Note that German asks [[wie]] (how), not 'what'.
German asks 'how is your address?' ([[Wie ist Ihre Adresse?]]). Like Russian (Какой у вас адрес?, not Что ...), German avoids 'what' here: 'Was ist Ihre Adresse?' sounds wrong.

sections.title: German addresses
sections.text:
Street first, then the house number, then the postcode and the city:

[[Hauptstraße 12]]
[[80331 München]]

The street is read as written: [[Hauptstraße zwölf]]. Postcodes are usually read digit by digit: [[acht, null, drei, drei, eins]].

items.de: Wie ist Ihre Adresse? - Hauptstraße zwölf, München.
items.en: What is your address? - Hauptstraße 12, Munich.

items.de: Meine Handynummer ist null, eins, fünf, zwei, drei, vier.

items.en: Can you write that down, please?

sections.text: Forms at offices and doctors usually ask for [[Vorname]] (first name) and [[Nachname]] (surname) separately. Write your name exactly as in your passport, and be ready to spell it (Unit 0, lesson 4).

items.de: Meine Postleitzahl ist acht, null, drei, drei, eins.

items.en: Can you write that down, please?

items.text: Wie ist Ihre ___? - Hauptstraße zwölf, München.
items.explanation: die Adresse. Nouns start with a capital letter.

items.question: What do they want to know?

items.explanation: German asks with wie: Wie ist Ihre E-Mail-Adresse?

items.instruction: Listen and write the numbers as words.
items.text: Meine Nummer ist null, eins, sieben, sechs.
items.explanation: Numbers as words, digit by digit.

Could you write that down, please?
